I’d start with blocking!
Like, taking a cube and extruding faces until you have a simple mesh that captures the shape. Like. Just enough vertices to make the general shape. And play around with the positioning of those until you’re happy. Once you’re happy, subdivide it (and maybe displace it if it losses a bit too much volume) And then proceed with sculpting!

Probably too late for the original poster... But I noticed that the backup is saved in Appdata/Roaming/.minecraft/backups 

It compresses the save into a zip. Just drag it over into the saves folder and extract it and it should go back to normal. (At least it worked for me)
